creativeDirection.title: The idea that refused to stay on paper
creativeDirection.sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
creativeDirection.about: The gap between the world you imagine and the material you have to make it. A small paper boat escapes a blank page and survives an ocean; the final reveal shows this world was made from a brief and edited in AutoPromote.
creativeDirection.whyCare: Everyone has an idea they cannot yet turn into something others can see. The fragile boat makes that struggle visible.
creativeDirection.hook: A paper boat on a desk moves as the desk becomes an ocean. Impossible but immediately readable.
creativeDirection.beginning: A single ordinary sheet becomes a boat; one idea, no footage.
creativeDirection.development: The boat becomes the central subject of a much larger cinematic world.
creativeDirection.tension: A dark wave threatens the fragile boat. Will the idea survive becoming real?
creativeDirection.payoff: A warm path of light opens across the ocean; the boat survives. The camera reveals the created world as editable material in the real AutoPromote Studio.
creativeDirection.ending: The finished world fills the screen again: A brief. No footage. AutoPromote.
creativeDirection.withheld: The origin of the footage and the AutoPromote identity until the payoff.
amplify: The small boat against the dark wave
The reveal of this exact footage in the real Studio
creativeDirection.soundDirection: Dry paper texture and a restrained ticking pulse at the desk; ocean and a low tense swell for the storm; a deliberate near-silence before a warm harmonic resolution. Original instrumental score, no imitation voice or placeholder beeps.
reviewCriteria: Storm feels threatening without chaotic geometry
AutoPromote reveal uses actual product UI

shots.name: paper-awakens
shots.prompt: Photoreal cinematic miniature world, tactile ivory origami paper boat with one crisp triangular sail and sharply folded hull, no writing on the paper. Warm amber practical light against deep petrol-blue shadows, natural film contrast, 35mm commercial cinematography. The same single small ivory paper boat is the only hero object. Extreme close-up at table level. A small ivory origami sailboat rests on a dark wooden desk beside one blank sheet of paper. A thin shimmering pool of water slowly spreads underneath the boat; the boat lifts gently and floats as the desk surface becomes a deep blue ocean. An impossible transformation shown with physically convincing water and crisp stable folds. Slow controlled camera push. Quiet amber light from the left. One uninterrupted five-second shot.
